fields.label: Local Connector URL
fields.description: Base URL for local device connectors. For WMN Payment Bridge use the URL shown in the Flutter app, for example http://10.x.x.x:8787.

fields.label: Bridge Provider
fields.description: Provider executed by WMN Payment Bridge for Android App Bridge transport.

fields.label: Bridge Token
fields.description: Local WMN Payment Bridge token. Kept server-side and never sent to the POS browser.

fields.label: API Base URL (Optional Override)
fields.description: For Geidea KSA leave blank to use the official KSA merchant endpoint. Set only for a certified Geidea-compatible test/proxy endpoint.

fields.label: Authorize Endpoint
fields.description: Generic providers only. Geidea uses its certified Create Session endpoint.

fields.label: Refund Endpoint
fields.description: Generic providers only. Geidea uses its certified Refund endpoint.

fields.label: API Key / Merchant Public Key
fields.description: For Geidea enter the Merchant Public Key issued for your Sandbox or Production merchant account.

fields.label: API Secret / API Password
fields.description: For Geidea enter the API Password. This value stays server-side and is never sent to the POS browser.
